Enjoy this super hit song from the 1972 movie Joru Ka Ghulam starring Rajesh Khanna, Nanda, Om Prakash, Ramesh Deo in the lead role. Enjoy this romantic song.
Song : Nainon Me Nindiya Hai
Movie : Joroo Ka Ghulam (1972)
Star Cast : Rajesh Khanna, Nanda, Om Parkesh, Ramesh Deo
Singer : Kishore Kumar, Lata Mangeshkar
Music : Kalyanji Anandji
Lyricist : Anand Bakshi
